title: EconTone candidate move
description: One structured modification proposed by a player (a skill, or a sub-agent acting as a proposer). The move is a claim; the scripts decide whether it is accepted.

after.description: path to the full text produced by applying this move, relative to the moves file

base.description: path to the text this move was built from; a move whose base is not the current text is stale and is skipped rather than applied

gate.description: mechanical = applied before round 1, never voted on

claimed.description: what the proposer expects to happen; never used for the decision
